name: nera-chat
description: Build-free app: nothing here is shipped. devDependencies are QC tooling only.

scripts.test:coverage: c8 --reporter=none --temp-directory coverage/raw node scripts/test-rerun.mjs && node scripts/coverage-remap.mjs coverage/raw coverage/v8 && c8 report --temp-directory coverage/v8 --report-dir coverage --reporter=text-summary --reporter=json-summary --reporter=lcov --all --src js --include 'js/**' --exclude 'js/vendor/**' --exclude 'js/firebase-config*.js' && node scripts/ratchet.mjs coverage
scripts.qc: npm run check:syntax && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:qc && npm run test:coverage
